title: apply --push keeps only check's first 10 problem lines, so the redact note is cut from the refusal text when check prints more
goal: the refusal text apply --push writes carries check's redact note whatever the number of problem lines, so the operator always sees where the remedy is written
repro_reason: a store with 10 or more failing entries and a refused push is needed to run it; the slice that drops the note is the line the fix changes
